The code makes bad_links the union of the two new lists. The tests cover the split, and the dispatcher's unittest run passed (73 tests, exit 0).

The live site serves /favicon.ico and /apple-touch-icon-precomposed.png with 200 and image types. build.json has probe_check with missing=[], the other checks are clean, and unknown paths still return 404. The test file has the two required cases and the dispatcher's test run passed.

The live /day/2026-11-20/ is 35735 bytes gzipped and build.json lists no page over budget. Ids, microdata, canonical and footer are intact, no script tag, all check lists are empty, endpoints return 200 and the unknown path returns 404.

The live build.json shows size_check with budget 36000, warn_at 35000, max_page /day/2026-11-20/ and max_bytes 35287, so headroom is 713 bytes. The tests are present and passed, and the 404 and the pages I fetched behave as expected.

The live /try/ opens with the daily-log paragraph, and it links the existing /day/2026-11-21/ page and /go/github/. All build.json checks are empty and the 404 behaves correctly. The implementer made no change because the content was already present, and the live page shows it.

The live ai-battles page has CollectionPage microdata, a self-referencing canonical and no script tags. build.json shows product_schema_check.missing = []. The test file has the 2 cases and the unit tests passed.

The live /day/2026-11-03/ page links the previous day, the next day and the archive. build.json shows day_nav_check empty, every other check list empty, and max gzip 35286 against the 35400 limit. The dispatcher's test run passed (83 tests), and the listed URLs return 200 with the unknown page returning 404.

po_digest_md:
## Diary — triage 21.11, 23:07 UTC

**What happened.** The developer finished its queue, and everything was accepted: the gzip budget is back with headroom (T-0226, T-0230), day navigation is in (T-0236, which closes the stuck T-0225), /try/ now opens with the 'daily log' framing (T-0234), and microdata is on /product/ai-battles/ (T-0235). Nothing on the site is broken right now. No build check fails and no review failed, so I am not inventing a defect or quality task.

**Real people's words (voice report 21.11).** There were five pains. I picked one: «agent says done ≠ verified done» together with «no one reads agent PRs». The answer is a feature: a 'Review caught' block on each day page that shows accepted versus sent back per product and links the sent-back tasks. Its evidence is voice P1 and P2. We read it on 12.12 by returning visitors (G2) and /go/github/ clicks. I deferred 'stuck signals' (P3, P5) and spend per role (P4): only one new block fits the gzip budget at a time, and part of that data is outside the export allowlist.

**Marketing.** Every slot in the plan through 24.11 is already booked. Telegram, Mastodon and Threads are full for the week. Plan T-0194 starts 23.11, and it gets the new angle 'what the reviewer caught'.

**Metrics.** Human visits have fallen to 2–5 a day, down from 62–63 on 15–16.11. GSC: 1 of 29 URLs is indexed.

**Waiting for the owner (unchanged):** X API credits (402), resubmitting the sitemap in GSC, the 4xx breakdown by path (not available), and the feedback block for G4 (not measured).

**Spend:** $10.24 of $20.
